The link you've provided (`g.co/gemini/share/...`) is a public link to a chat from Google's Gemini Apps. Anyone with this link can view the conversation and, depending on the chat's settings, potentially continue it .

Here is a breakdown of what you can typically do with such a link.

| **Capability** | **Description** |
| :--- | :--- |
| **View the Chat** | Read the entire conversation as it appeared when the link was created . |
| **Continue the Chat** | Pick up where the original conversation left off and chat with Gemini on your own (not available for chats created with Gems or for users under 18) . |
| **Reshare the Chat** | Copy the public link and share it with others . |
| **Report the Chat** | Use the "Report" option on the shared chat page if you find its content inappropriate . |

### 🔒 Important Privacy Notes

When dealing with shared Gemini chats, it's good to be aware of a few things:

*   **Link-Based Access**: Anyone with the link can access the chat, even if they didn't receive it directly from the original creator .
*   **Content Visibility**: If the original chat included an uploaded image, that image will be visible and downloadable from the shared chat page .
*   **Link Deletion**: Only the person who created the public link can delete it. Once deleted, the link will no longer work, but it cannot remove the chat from the activity history of others who may have continued the conversation .
